prompt:
Write 6 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim, in time order. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1251; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Entry 1: Claim reported by the insured's representative following a collision at an intersection where our driver was turning left across oncoming traffic. The claimant's attorney has requested that all contact be routed through their office.

Entry 2: Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant's vehicle was involved and that the claimant was present in the driver's seat at the scene. Two independent witnesses and the other driver describe the collision the same way, and scene photos are consistent with that account.

Entry 3: Inspected the vehicle damage. The pattern and location of the impact match the described collision, and there is no sign of earlier damage to the same areas. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy's coverage start.

Entry 4: Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy as a named driver. The claimant has given the same account of events in each conversation so far, with no changes in the sequence of events.

Entry 5: Medical records show a shoulder injury, which fits the type and force of impact described. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the claimant's history or available records. Treatment has followed a typical course and eased as the claimant improved.

Entry 6: Based on the documentation reviewed, the injury, vehicle damage and liability picture are consistent with the reported loss. Claim remains open pending final medical updates and settlement discussions with counsel.
